title: 17 Years of Melrish Weddings: What This Journey Really Taught Us
excerpt: Behind every decade of weddings is a story of trust, timelines, and real human moments.
content:
Seventeen years ago we stepped into our first ballroom with borrowed lights and notebooks full of timelines. Along the way, clients invited us past the contract—to birthday dinners, vow renewals, and quiet celebrations with family.

What we learnt is straightforward: ceremonies change and palettes change, but people still want honesty in the frames and calm in the room. We're carrying that into every enquiry we answer today.

title: A Wedding That Reminded Us Why We Do This
excerpt: Some weekends reset the compass—this one did.
content:
The rain rewrote every outdoor shot we had scripted. Instead of scrambling, families opened umbrellas, playlists slowed down, and the couple laughed through every delay.

We left remembering that artistry without empathy is hollow. Days like that are why Magic Frame stays small enough to respond, and obsessive enough about craft.

title: It's a Connection Beyond the Contract
excerpt: Long after deliverables sync, relationships keep the story alive.
content:
Contracts protect scope; relationships protect meaning. We've watched alumni clients send voice notes asking for reunion shoots, and founders send notes with stills we made seasons ago.

We sign paperwork because production demands it—we show up generously because longevity demands it.
